Bayesian hierarchical imputation of qPCR non-detects

Source: R/singlesample-nondetects.R
qpcr_nondetect_impute.Rd

Wraps nondetects::qpcrImpute for Ct-scale qPCR expression matrices. Falls back to LOD imputation (qpcr_nondetect_lod_fallback) when either nondetects or HTqPCR is unavailable, or when the Bayesian fit fails. Sets nondetect_method and n_imputed attributes on the returned matrix.

Usage

qpcr_nondetect_impute(expr_mat, log_handler = message)

Arguments

expr_mat

Numeric matrix (features-by-samples) of Ct values; NAs represent non-detects.

log_handler

Function used to emit progress messages. Default message.

Value

Matrix of the same shape as expr_mat with non-detects imputed. Carries attributes nondetect_method (one of "nondetects_qpcrImpute", "lod_fallback", "none_needed") and n_imputed (integer count of imputed cells).

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
m <- matrix(c(20, NA, 25, 30, NA, NA), nrow = 2,
            dimnames = list(c("miR-1", "miR-2"), c("S1", "S2", "S3")))
qpcr_nondetect_impute(m)
} # }
